note: One character per 5x5 map-unit cell (about 2.4 m). Row r, column c covers x in [c*5, c*5+5), y in [r*5, r*5+5). walkable: 1 = a person can stand there. Buildings, fields, courts, the pool and fenced-off areas are 0. core: 1 = the courtyards and walkways students actually use; a route should prefer core ground over parking lots without making the lots unreachable. Room pins sit on or just inside building walls, so a pin may be on a 0 cell: snap to the nearest walkable cell.
